provenance: User-pasted Gemini Independent Scientific Investigation for the Pregnancy Info App: Evidence Synthesis, Gap Audit, and Structured Study Registry. Gemini could not inspect repository. The supplied text stops at 13 references; no actual JSON payload was included. This file is an independently checked reconciliation, not a verbatim transcript.
scope: Selected source checks and registry crosswalk; staged overlay only. No full systematic screening or clinical review.

source_candidates.title: Genotype-informed docosahexaenoic acid dosing based on the FADS Indel to reduce preterm and prolonged gestation: A secondary analysis of the ADORE randomized trial
source_candidates.design: post hoc secondary analysis of randomized trial
source_candidates.checked_locator: Publisher full text, abstract, Results Fig 3 and S8–S10, funding/COI
source_candidates.finding: 761 of 1032 ADORE participants genotyped. I-allele group early preterm birth: 2/205 vs 9/214; total preterm 19/205 vs 31/214, higher vs lower DHA. D/D group prolonged gestation 49/191 vs 23/151.
source_candidates.limitations: Small event counts, selection into genotyping, post hoc subgroup. Not independent replication; no race-based or genetic dosing recommendations. Week 40 or later is study definition, not standard postterm birth.
source_candidates.funding: NIH R01HD083292; authors report funder had no role
source_candidates.authors: Li YN, Kothapalli KSD, Carlson SE, Gajewski BJ, DeFranco EA, Brenna JT

source_candidates.title: Regimens of vitamin D supplementation for women during pregnancy
source_candidates.finding: Higher-dose comparisons show little or no clear difference in several obstetric outcomes; separate question from vitamin D versus placebo.
source_candidates.limitations: Not a substitute for deficiency care or nutritional intake guidance. Full text, DOI, funding and overlap pending.
source_candidates.provenance: Additional research discovered during Gemini reconciliation

source_candidates.title: Impact of postpartum physical activity on maternal depression and anxiety: a systematic review and meta-analysis
source_candidates.finding: Exercise-only interventions reduced depressive symptom severity and anxiety severity; lower odds of postpartum depression.
source_candidates.limitations: Depression symptom heterogeneity high; not replacement for indicated mental health treatment; exercise-only subset differs from total review.

source_candidates.title: Impact of postpartum physical activity on cardiometabolic health, breastfeeding, injury and infant growth and development: a systematic review and meta-analysis
source_candidates.checked_locator: PubMed indexed title/eligibility; outcome details need further extraction
source_candidates.finding: Relevant review identified. Gemini reports no adverse lactation signal and cardiometabolic benefits; hold precise estimates until results checked.
source_candidates.limitations: Do not infer universal safety or equivalence, or cosmetic breast outcomes.

source_candidates.title: Two Randomized Trials of Low-Dose Calcium Supplementation in Pregnancy
source_candidates.finding: 500 versus 1500 mg/day: preterm birth India RR .89 (.80–.98); Tanzania RR 1.07 (.95–1.21). Tanzania did not establish noninferiority.
source_candidates.limitations: No placebo comparison. Noninferiority outcome-specific; do not replace guideline or prescribe a dose. Crosslink two trial cohorts to DR003 and S092/S093 where eligible.

source_candidates.title: Randomized controlled trial of digital cognitive behavior therapy for prenatal insomnia symptoms: effects on postpartum insomnia and mental health
source_candidates.finding: Probable major depression at 3 months postpartum 4% intervention vs 18% standard care; subgroup with minimal baseline symptoms 0% vs 18%.
source_candidates.limitations: Screening-defined outcome, subgroup, no new independent trial; not substitute for mental health care. Extract denominators, confidence intervals, attrition and commercial involvement.

source_candidates.title: Acitretin capsule prescribing information
source_candidates.finding: Avoid pregnancy during therapy and at least three years after stopping; nursing restriction is separate.
source_candidates.limitations: Do not infer an identical fixed three-year breastfeeding washout from pregnancy warning. Prescriber handles medication plans.
source_candidates.provenance: Gemini lead; independently checked US label

source_candidates.title: Efficacy of topical silicone gel in scar management: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
source_candidates.checked_locator: Indexed PubMed title; numerical details pending
source_candidates.finding: Relevant scar review identified; Gemini reports VSS pigmentation, height and pliability improvements.
source_candidates.limitations: Mixed scar populations; no automatic transfer to cesarean-specific outcomes or open wounds.

interval_candidates.outcome: early preterm birth <34 weeks, I allele

duplicate_or_existing.note: Cochrane and older topical trials already present; almond and coconut studies exist despite Gemini retrieval gaps. Keep limitations and nonpregnant treatment distinction.
Existing observational breast appearance and support evidence; no causal feeding advice.
Beamish, binder reviews, Prevett and acute heavy-load studies already represented. Do not add duplicate trial counts.

Cochrane omega-3, folate, 2024 vitamin D, calcium, probiotics, choline, ORIP/ADORE and emerging human creatine study already in registry. No source retrieval by Gemini does not establish absence of human evidence.
Prior staged calcium IPD and fertility retraction dependency audit remain controlling; Gemini did not complete these. DR027 CDC folate guidance already staged.
Perineal massage, cesarean laser comparator, compression trial, venous/periodontal Cochrane, CBT-I, hydroquinone lactation and perineal PBM already covered or staged.

safety_corrections.finding: Common MTHFR variants do not establish need to replace folic acid with 5-MTHF; CDC recommends folic acid, which has direct NTD prevention evidence. DHFR substitution claim unverified. CDC clinician guidance starts at least one month before conception; three months can be planning preference not universal minimum.

Acute fetal hemodynamic outcomes and self-selected lifting survey cannot establish universal heavy-lifting, Valsalva or supine exercise safety. No home fetal heart-rate thresholds or blanket clearance.
Acitretin pregnancy avoidance period is at least 3 years; nursing warning separate. Do not promise safe conception solely from an elapsed isotretinoin washout.
No personalized genotype/race-based DHA dose or testing recommendation. Bayesian posterior probabilities are not individual benefit probabilities; credible intervals differ from confidence intervals.
Gemini conflates anxiety and depression effect sizes. Depression SMD -.52; anxiety -.25; maintain separate outcomes.
LactMed reports lack of breastfeeding hydroquinone studies, not proven harm; distinguish precaution/unknown from established contraindication. Retain pregnancy avoidance and existing retinoid holds.
Vitamin D 2024 review addresses uncertainty of supplementation for obstetric outcomes; 2026 dose comparison is distinct. Do not infer dietary requirement or deficiency treatment is unnecessary.
Pneumatic compression vs rest is not a stocking-prevention trial; existing S127 evaluates stockings. Distinguish symptom relief, structural prevention and VTE care.

unverified_leads: PBM nipple lesions meta-analysis and lactation-specific harms; verify exact DOI and comparator; vendor energy limits excluded as clinical guidance.
Moolyk heavy lifting and Norwegian athlete cohort; check H033–H036 and underlying cohorts before adding.
Iron alternate-day absorption populations, ferritin thresholds and IV iron eligibility; verify current obstetric guidelines, do not import editorial thresholds as universal.
Paternal exposure epigenetics and offspring outcomes; separate animals and observational humans; no causal risk forecasts.
Scar microneedling, CaHA/MFU and general telogen effluvium ferritin cutoffs; extract primary population and safety.
Felder 2020 original and follow-up linkage, 2026 CBT-I trial registration, missing full structured registry.

Perineal massage, bariatric intervals, multiple pregnancies, protein, acne/lactation medications, supplement harms, unresolved primary reports; use existing backlog and targeted audit rather than assume missing evidence.
hold_rule: Exclude retracted trials DR023–025; hold affected male-fertility pooled estimates DR021/022, not entire review unrelated outcomes. Preserve prior release holds and all clinical-review gates. No auto-publish or automatic dosing.
